verdict.efficiency (energy absorption, stiffness: no: <0.5 % of the landing energy even with full coverage
verdict.safety - structural health monitoring: yes: PZT wafers as Lamb-wave actuators/sensors find delaminations and impact damage in the composite leaf and its attachment between inspections
verdict.nose-gear shimmy: marginal: shunted patches add ~1-2 % damping to a mode; a conventional shimmy damper is lighter and certifiable
verdict.energy harvesting: tens of microjoules: enough to wake a logger, not to power it
